Bhūpa
-Nyāyakaumudī. SB. New D.. VIII. ii. 97817 (Śabdakhaṇḍa; inc.).

Bhūpacandra
king of Sahagila family, mentioned in Śrāddhakalpalatā of Nandapaṇḍita, IO. 1731.

Bhūpacaryā
or Bhūpālavallabha. med. by Sundaradeva, son of Govindadeva an. disciple of Viśvarūpatīrtha. IO. 2704 (inc.).

Bhūpajājalpita
or Bilhaṇapañcāśatpratyuttara. in 56 v.. by Bhūvara; continuation of Caurapañcāśikā, which describes the wailing of the princess Śaśikalā. [Page204b] Bd. 430. BORI. 430 of 1887-91. BORI. D. XIII. ii. 438.
See S. N. Dasgupta, HSL. Classical Period, Vol. I. p. 659 fn.; also S. N. Tadpatrikar in Ann. Bh. Inst. 9, 1927-28 p. 18 ff.

Bhūpañcākṣaramantra
addressed to Goddess Lakṣmī under the name Bhū. MD. 6840.

Bhūpati
(C. 1613 A. D.). See Sen, Bibl. of Astron. p. 71.
-Gaṇitāmṛta jy. See under the text.
Addl. mss.:
RORI. III. B. 7443. SB. New D.. IX. 34596.

Bhūpati(upādhyāya)
-Jātakadīpikā. VVRI. I. p. 83.
-Pañcāṅgapatrasāriṇī. RORI. III. B. 7829.
-Bhūbala. Mithilā.

Bhūpatiprayoga
med. SB. New D.. XII. ii. 108416 (inc.). C.. Bhūpacaryā above.

Bhūpatibhāgyaratnāvali
sn. of Yavanajātakasaṃhitā. Bikaner 5017.

Bhūpatimiśra
q. in Rasakalpadruma of Caturbhuja. See Krishnamachariar, HCSL. Sn. 904.

Bhūpatimiśra
-Camatkāracintāmaṇi. Saurashtra p. 39. [Page205a]

Bhūpatimiśra
-Tithinirṇaya. Mithilā. I. 157. Mentions Hemādri an. Bhoja. See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1201a.

Bhūpatimiśra
-Pratipadādinirṇaya. Mithilā.

Bhūpatimiśra
-Vidagdhabodha. Luck. Uni. p. 36. PUL. II. p. 92 (2 mss.). RORI. II. B. 4059-60.

Bhūpativallabha
or Bhūpālaº. See below.

Bhūpativallabha
or Rājavallabhamaṇḍana or Vāstuvallabhamaṇḍana by Maṇḍana-sūtradhāra, son of Śrīkṣetra, vāstu. See under Rājavallabhamaṇḍana.

Bhūpatiśālivāhanakathā
or Śālivāhanakathā by Śivadāsa. IO. 4103.

Bhūpatistuti

Bhūpasamuccaya

Bhūpāla
or ºrāja.
-Kṛtyasamuccaya. mentioned in Samayapradīpa, Dānaratnākara; q. by Raghunandana in his Śuddhitattva; by Śrīdattopādhyāya in his Chandogāhnika; by Caṇḍeśvara in his Kṛtyaratnākara an. Ḍāmaratantra.
